lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，鼻子几乎拖土
lines.en: I walk low, my snout almost dragging the dirt.

lines.zh: 沿着腐肉的味道慢慢挪
lines.en: I shuffle along the smell of carrion.

lines.zh: 走几步就停，怕有更大的在附近
lines.en: A few steps, then a halt, wary of something bigger.

lines.zh: 我头骨上的皱褶在光下一道道
lines.en: The wrinkles on my skull ridge show in the light.

lines.zh: 爪子很轻，走路几乎没声
lines.en: Light claws, so my walk is nearly silent.

lines.zh: 我绕过那具尸体，先确认没主
lines.en: I circle the carcass, checking it has no owner.

lines.zh: 身体小，我走得很谨慎
lines.en: Small body, so I walk carefully.

lines.zh: 我边走边嗅，脖子低低的
lines.en: I walk and sniff, neck kept low.

lines.zh: 背后有响动，我立刻贴地
lines.en: A sound behind me and I press to the ground.

lines.zh: 我从大恐龙的足迹旁走过
lines.en: I pass beside the tracks of something much larger.

lines.zh: 我侧身穿过倒木，几乎擦着
lines.en: I slip sideways under the fallen log.

lines.zh: 每一步都在试探，不敢走满
lines.en: Every step tests the ground, never full weight.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里走，尽量不显眼
lines.en: I walk in the shade, trying not to stand out.

lines.zh: 走近腐肉时，我加快了半步
lines.en: Approaching the carrion I speed up half a step.

lines.zh: 我蹲在腐肉边上，先不急着吃
lines.en: I crouch by the carrion, in no rush to eat.

lines.zh: 头上那道皱褶，看起来像疤
lines.en: The wrinkle on my skull looks like a scar.

lines.zh: 我听四周的动静，比看更准
lines.en: I listen around me; hearing beats sight.

lines.zh: 一只秃鹫在上空绕，我抬头看
lines.en: A vulture circles overhead; I look up.

lines.zh: 这副身体不够强，我知道
lines.en: This body is not strong enough; I know it.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子贴在地上，慢慢吸气
lines.en: I press my snout to the ground and inhale slowly.

lines.zh: 牙齿细而密，撕腐肉正好
lines.en: Fine close teeth, perfect for tearing carrion.

lines.zh: 我在等别的猎手吃完再过去
lines.en: I wait for the other hunters to finish first.

lines.zh: 风一变，我就把头低下去
lines.en: When the wind shifts, I lower my head.

lines.zh: 这地上有新鲜的血，还没干
lines.en: Fresh blood on the ground, not yet dry.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔自己的前爪
lines.en: I lick my own foreclaw.

lines.zh: 身体瘦，肚子却一直饿
lines.en: A lean body, and a stomach that stays hungry.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了看最大的那具骨架
lines.en: I glance at the largest skeleton there.

lines.zh: 没有机会的时候，我就等着
lines.en: When there is no chance, I simply wait.

lines.zh: 我从低处抬头看你，眼睛亮
lines.en: I look up at you from low, eyes bright.

lines.zh: 我先看你的手，再看你的脚
lines.en: I check your hands first, then your feet.

lines.zh: 你比我大很多，我退后一点
lines.en: You are much larger; I edge back a little.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，让自己更小
lines.en: I crouch, making myself smaller.

lines.zh: 但你身上有血味，我闻到了
lines.en: But you smell of blood, and I caught it.

lines.zh: 我在算：你倒下，我能吃多久
lines.en: I am calculating how long you would feed me.

lines.zh: 我偏头，第一次没有躲
lines.en: I tilt my head and, for once, do not hide.

lines.zh: 皱褶上还有一道旧伤，别碰
lines.en: There is an old wound on my ridges; do not touch it.

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔着一具骨架
lines.en: Only a carcass lies between us.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音很短
lines.en: I give a short cry.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里站着，不动
lines.en: I stand still inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 如果你是新的猎手，我会跟着你
lines.en: If you are the new hunter, I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我试探着往前半步，又收回
lines.en: I try half a step forward, then take it back.

lines.zh: 别把我当成弱者，我活得比你久
lines.en: Do not count me weak; I have outlived many.

lines.zh: 我露出牙，只是习惯
lines.en: I bare my teeth; it is only habit.

lines.zh: 你动，我就动，速度不慢
lines.en: You move and I move, and I am not slow.

lines.zh: 我痛得贴在地上，一动不动
lines.en: Pain pins me flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的算计
lines.en: That blow ruins my calculations.

lines.zh: 我叫得很短，怕引来更大的
lines.en: I cry briefly, afraid of drawing something bigger.

lines.zh: 我护住喉咙，往后退
lines.en: I guard my throat and back off.

lines.zh: 肋骨一阵一阵疼，我弓起背
lines.en: My ribs ache in waves; I arch my back.

lines.zh: 血滴在我自己的脚印上
lines.en: Blood drips onto my own tracks.

lines.zh: 我踉跄着钻进蕨丛
lines.en: I stagger into the ferns.

lines.zh: 这身体本来就撑不住多少
lines.en: This body could never take much.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，仍然没跑远
lines.en: I grit my teeth and still do not flee far.

lines.zh: 谁打的，我记着
lines.en: Whoever hit me, I will remember.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，我几乎跑起来
lines.en: The smell of carrion nearly makes me run.

lines.zh: 我没得挑，能吃的都算
lines.en: I cannot be choosy; anything edible counts.

lines.zh: 我低头叼住就往后拖
lines.en: I grab it low and drag it backward.

lines.zh: 这块肉没人守着吧
lines.en: Nobody is guarding this meat, right?

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边看四周
lines.en: I eat while watching all around.

lines.zh: 你的手太近了，我停一下
lines.en: Your hand is too close; I pause.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，胆子会变大
lines.en: Hunger makes me bolder.

lines.zh: 我撕下一块，退到草丛里
lines.en: I tear off a piece and retreat into the grass.

lines.zh: 这一顿够我撑两天
lines.en: This meal will last me two days.

lines.zh: 我闻到肉就忘了害怕
lines.en: The smell of meat makes me forget fear.

lines.zh: 我被撞得贴着地滑出去，肋骨硌疼。
lines.en: The hit skids me flat across the ground and my ribs ache.

lines.zh: 我太轻，一撞就退老远
lines.en: Too light; one hit sends me far.

lines.zh: 我反口咬了一下，又立刻退开
lines.en: I snap back once, then retreat at once.

lines.zh: 身体撞上你的腿，我站不稳
lines.en: I hit your leg and cannot hold my footing.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，从你旁边挤过去
lines.en: I duck low and squeeze past you.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我肋骨响
lines.en: The impact makes my ribs click.

lines.zh: 我缩起脖子，护住喉咙
lines.en: I tuck my neck to guard my throat.

lines.zh: 地上的土粘在我肚皮上
lines.en: Dirt sticks to my belly.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，眼睛没离开
lines.en: I back two steps, eyes never leaving.

lines.zh: 我们撞过之后，我记住了你的力量
lines.en: After the collision I remember your strength.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，贴近你的颈
lines.en: I lower my head against your neck.

lines.zh: 我们在骨架边互相嗅
lines.en: We sniff each other beside a skeleton.

lines.zh: 窝藏在一丛蕨下，很隐蔽
lines.en: The nest hides under a fern, well concealed.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把土拨开，挖个浅坑
lines.en: I claw the soil aside into a shallow hollow.

lines.zh: 我发出很轻的喉音
lines.en: A very soft throaty sound comes from me.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着，谁也不敢睡死
lines.en: We take turns guarding; neither sleeps deeply.

lines.zh: 两个瘦弱的身体靠在一起取暖
lines.en: Two lean bodies lean together for warmth.

lines.zh: 风里有腐肉味，也有你的味
lines.en: The wind carries carrion, and also you.

lines.zh: 这地方不安全，我们得换
lines.en: This place is unsafe; we must move.

lines.zh: 我轻轻碰你的喙侧
lines.en: I gently touch the side of your snout.

lines.zh: 我叼起这块腐肉，很沉
lines.en: I lift this carrion; it is heavy.

lines.zh: 有蛆，我照样吃
lines.en: There are maggots, and I eat it anyway.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断骨，先放着
lines.en: I pick up a broken bone and set it aside.

lines.zh: 我撕不动，只能一点点啃
lines.en: I cannot tear it, so I nibble bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我把东西压在脚下，慢慢吃
lines.en: I pin it under my foot and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 这一块比我的头还大
lines.en: This piece is bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 叼着它我跑不快，得小心
lines.en: Carrying this slows me, so I must be careful.

lines.zh: 我边吃边后退，习惯这样
lines.en: I eat while backing away; it is my habit.

lines.zh: 我叼到蕨丛里藏起来
lines.en: I carry it into the ferns and hide it.

lines.zh: 有别的食客来了，我抢走就跑
lines.en: Another diner arrives; I snatch it and run.

lines.zh: 你落单了，我在算风险
lines.en: You are alone; I am weighing the risk.

lines.zh: 这点体格，我或许能拿下
lines.en: That build, I might be able to take.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，眼睛就定了
lines.en: I smell blood, and my eyes fix.

lines.zh: 我先看你有没有同伴
lines.en: I check first whether you have companions.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，从侧面包抄
lines.en: I crouch and circle to your flank.

lines.zh: 它比我小，这个可以试
lines.en: It is smaller than me; this one is worth a try.

lines.zh: 我盯着伤处，那里好下口
lines.en: I watch the wound; that is where to bite.

lines.zh: 机会只有一次，我算好了
lines.en: There is only one chance, and I have planned it.

lines.zh: 我咬住就撤，不恋战
lines.en: I bite and withdraw, never overstaying.

lines.zh: 这具身体饿太久了
lines.en: This body has been hungry too long.

lines.zh: 我低声吼，先吓一吓
lines.en: I growl low, trying to startle first.

lines.zh: 你转身的瞬间，我做了决定
lines.en: When you turn, I decide.

lines.zh: 小的更好，大的留给别人
lines.en: The small one is better; the big one I leave to others.

lines.zh: 我尝过血腥味，就回不去了
lines.en: I have tasted blood, and there is no going back.

lines.zh: 我贴地跟着你，尽量不发声
lines.en: I track you low, making as little noise as I can.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我绕到哪
lines.en: Wherever you go, I swing around you.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己受伤
lines.en: I am waiting for you to get hurt.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停，草都没动
lines.en: You stop, and so do I; not a blade stirs.

lines.zh: 我咬一下就跑，你别追
lines.en: I bite once and run; do not chase.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比我的牙长
lines.en: My patience is longer than my teeth.

lines.zh: 你要是撑不住，我就上
lines.en: If you falter, I move in.

lines.zh: 我沿着你脚印的边贴着走
lines.en: I follow the edge of your tracks.

lines.zh: 另一头大的在附近，我得快
lines.en: Something big is near; I must be quick.

lines.zh: 我盯着你起伏的胸口，数到第七下。
lines.en: I watch your chest rise and fall, counting to the seventh.

lines.zh: 这地方藏身的地方多，对我有利
lines.en: Plenty of cover here, which favors me.

lines.zh: 我不正面来，从来不来
lines.en: I never come at you head-on, never.

lines.zh: 我在你身后十步，一直没远
lines.en: Ten paces behind you, never further.

lines.zh: 你回头看的时候，我已经趴下
lines.en: When you look back, I am already flat.

lines.zh: 机会快到了，我能闻出来
lines.en: The chance is near; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的后腿，立刻松口
lines.en: I bite your hind leg and release at once.

lines.zh: 爪子划过，留一道浅口
lines.en: My claws rake a shallow line.

lines.zh: 我从侧面扑一下就走
lines.en: I lunge from the side and leave.

lines.zh: 这一口不是勇气，是饿
lines.en: This bite is not courage; it is hunger.

lines.zh: 我跳起来咬，落回原地
lines.en: I leap, bite, and land back where I started.

lines.zh: 你转身太快，我只咬到皮
lines.en: You turn too fast; I only catch hide.

lines.zh: 我扯下一块就退开
lines.en: I tear off a piece and retreat.

lines.zh: 被打中我也要咬回来
lines.en: Even struck, I bite back.

lines.zh: 皱褶里的皮肤绷紧了
lines.en: The skin over my crest ridges tightens.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里咕咕响，像在算计
lines.en: A rumble in my throat, as if counting.

lines.zh: 第二下我没敢上
lines.en: I dare not make a second try.

lines.zh: 血味让我更想再咬一口
lines.en: The blood smell makes me want another bite.

lines.zh: 我绕过你的正面，找你后背
lines.en: I skirt your front and go for your back.

lines.zh: 咬完我就躲进蕨丛
lines.en: After the bite I vanish into the ferns.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道把我引来了
lines.en: The smell of carrion brought me here.

lines.zh: 我从蕨丛里钻出来，很瘦
lines.en: I slip out of the ferns, lean and hungry.

lines.zh: 头骨上那道皱褶先露出来
lines.en: That wrinkled skull shows first.

lines.zh: 我踩着别的恐龙的脚印过来
lines.en: I come along another dinosaur's tracks.

lines.zh: 这里刚死过东西，我知道
lines.en: Something died here recently; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我压着脚步，尽量不惊动谁
lines.en: I keep my steps light, avoiding attention.

lines.zh: 远处有大的在叫，我得小心
lines.en: Something big calls far off; I must be careful.

lines.zh: 我绕着尸体走了一圈才靠近
lines.en: I circle the body once before approaching.

lines.zh: 一声低短的叫声，很突然
lines.en: A short, sudden cry.

lines.zh: 我闻到了新鲜的血，还很热
lines.en: I smell fresh blood, still warm.

lines.zh: 落单的食腐者，就是这样出现的
lines.en: This is how a lone scavenger arrives.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里站了一会儿才动
lines.en: I stand in the shade a while before moving.

lines.zh: 肚子贴着脊骨，我饿得发慌
lines.en: My belly is pressed to my spine with hunger.

lines.zh: 这片地界上，比我强的太多
lines.en: Too many here are stronger than me.

lines.zh: 我瘦弱的影子落在地上，很细
lines.en: My thin shadow falls on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从骨架底下穿过，像回家
lines.en: I walk under a ribcage as if coming home.

lines.zh: 我来了，带着饥饿和耐心
lines.en: I have arrived, with hunger and patience.

lines.zh: 骨头乱响的地方，总有我
lines.en: Where bones clatter, I am always nearby.

lines.zh: 火燎过背脊，我窜出去老远
lines.en: Fire scorches my spine; I bolt far away.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，瘦骨头硌得生疼
lines.en: I land hard, my thin bones aching.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进鼻子，我拼命抬头
lines.en: Muddy water fills my snout; I strain to lift my head.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到骨架那边
lines.en: The blast throws me toward the skeleton.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿进肋侧，我喘不上气
lines.en: An arrow pierces my flank and I cannot catch my breath.

lines.zh: 身体里发冷，像被什么东西抓住
lines.en: Something cold grips me from inside.

lines.zh: 饿到发抖，我连骨头都想啃
lines.en: Shaking with hunger, I would even chew bone.

lines.zh: 雷顺着脊背下去，我腿都软了
lines.en: Lightning runs down my spine; my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我只能往下坠
lines.en: The ground is gone; I can only fall.
